description: Provisional research matrix for the Association Constitution Drafting Tool. All initial records await legal verification.

records.title: Constitutional personality choices
records.summary: How should members constitute the association, define continuity, and allocate authority over assets and contracts?

applicability.conditions: Research scope only; applicability has not been verified.

records.research_needed: Identify the common-law and case-law tests for separate legal personality and the effect of the proposed constitution.

change_history.note: Initial research record derived from the white paper; not a verified legal rule.

records.title: Founding-document requirements
records.summary: Which founding-document provisions apply when applying for NPO registration?

applicability.conditions: Research scope only; applicability has not been verified.

records.research_needed: Verify the current amended section 12 requirements, scope, and registration triggers; do not treat registration as a legal form.

change_history.note: Initial research record derived from the white paper; not a verified legal rule.
